description: ConnectionPropertiesV2 is polymorphic on `authType`; the converted model keeps only the base members, so S.Struct strips the subtype `credentials` (ApiKey key, CustomKeys keys, ServicePrincipal client secret, ...) on encode. Add it as an untyped document on the input shape shared by account and project connection PUT/PATCH.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Auth-type-specific credentials (polymorphic on `authType`), e.g. `{ key }` for ApiKey or `{ keys: {...} }` for CustomKeys. Write-only.
